dismissals.because: src/forge/repo.py:202 design_models is first called by forge work in the story's ROUTE task, whose tests/test_design_route.py covers the defaults through the real command

findings.body: The old-repository assertion only checks that `doctor` accepts a configuration without `[models.design]`. `src/forge/doctor.py:74` reads the configuration but never resolves design models, and no test exercises the default selection. Changing either `DESIGN_DEFAULTS` value or breaking the fallback at `src/forge/repo.py:204` would therefore leave this test passing. MODELS explicitly owns the defaults and their configuration coverage (plans/FORGE-DESIGN-1.md:50). The required test must establish that an existing repository receives `claude-opus-5-5` high and `gpt-6-sol` high when those entries are absent.
findings.title: Not done: test the design defaults for existing repositories
